data.description: Board request (chat DM @human:forrest, msg 116, 2026-08-30 17:43), verbatim: "thread chat is auto scrolling to the bottom on an interval - we should maintain scroll position. also, set me as the default user". Two items: (1) the poll-driven re-render jams the thread panel scroll to the bottom — preserve scroll position across poll re-renders (planner: check whether the main message list has the same defect); (2) when localStorage("chat.me") is unset, the UI should default to human:forrest instead of forcing a manual identity pick. NOTE: the thread sidebar itself is slated for replacement under the threads-inline/modal task (msg 119) — fix the scroll behavior at the poll/render level so it survives that redesign; do not couple the two tasks.
data.title: Chat: thread view must keep scroll position across polls; default identity = human:forrest

data.body: Bumped medium->high: board DM msg 160 (2026-08-30), verbatim: 'let's get going on all the chat UX improvements'. This is first in the UX queue — it's a bug (scroll-position loss on poll) plus a trivial default-identity change, cheapest to clear. Queue order set this tick: AS-17 -> AS-19 -> AS-23 (new, mobile layout) -> AS-18.

Plan written. Root cause: renderThread() ends with an unconditional pane.scrollTop=scrollHeight, re-run by the 5s poll. Fix at render level: new pure module public/scroll.js (isAtBottom + renderPreservingScroll) with sticky-bottom semantics — follow new messages when pinned at bottom, exact scrollTop restore when scrolled up; both #messages and #thread-messages go through it, so it survives the AS-19 thread redesign (container-agnostic, no coupling). Main list did NOT have the poll jam but had a latent nav defect (stale scroll offset on conversation switch) — covered by the same primitive. Identity: loadIdentities falls back to human:forrest (seeded in store.js) when chat.me is unset/stale; default is not persisted to localStorage. Unit tests follow the url-state.test.js pattern (node --test, no DOM).

Implemented per plan, commit dc32018. Built: public/scroll.js (isAtBottom + renderPreservingScroll, pure, zero deps, url-state.js pattern); both panes in app.js wired through it — renderThread({forceBottom}) with openThread forcing bottom, selectConversation scroll:'bottom'|'preserve' (poll + sendMessage preserve, navigation keeps 'bottom' which fixes the latent stale-offset-on-switch defect); unconditional thread scrollTop line deleted; m= anchor block untouched and still runs after the primitive. DEFAULT_IDENTITY='human:forrest' fallback in loadIdentities, deliberately not persisted to localStorage. test/scroll.test.js: 8 cases incl. slack boundary 39/40/41 and an engine-hostile fake pane that clobbers scrollTop mid-render. Full suite 111 pass / 0 fail. Left undone: the plan's manual Docker verification (browser-level check of both panes + fresh-profile identity) — flagging for QA to run against the live container.

QA review (cold, branch diff master...feat/AS-17-thread-scroll-default-identity, commits 7397fb0/dc32018/a613a73; metawork commit e85f283 confirmed CLAUDE.md + AS-25 .lattice only, orchestrator-attributed, not reviewed further).

VERDICT: FAIL — implementation-level rework needed. One blocking finding.

BLOCKER (violates criteria 1-3+5 functionally, and criterion 6's 'app.js panes both use it' in the served app): public/scroll.js is never served. server.js serves statics from an explicit STATIC_FILES allowlist (server.js:15-21) and /scroll.js was not added. app.js is an ES module; its 'import ./scroll.js' 404s, which fails the entire module graph — the whole chat UI is dead on this branch, not just scrolling. Repro (deterministic, branch image, throwaway container, live server untouched): boot createChatServer in the compose test image, GET /app.js -> 200, /scroll.js -> 404, /url-state.js -> 200. Precedent existed: AS-9 registered url-state.js in the allowlist AND added a served-over-HTTP test (test/api.test.js:304). Fix: one STATIC_FILES entry + mirror that test for /scroll.js. Root cause is partly the plan's 'No server, store, CLI, or CSS changes' line — factually wrong given the allowlist — but the architecture is sound, so this is implementation-level, not plan-level; the rework should also note the plan's Key-files table correction.

Per-criterion (verification level stated):
1. Thread scroll preserved across poll — logic PASS (code-trace: poll -> selectConversation scroll:'preserve' -> app.js:337 renderThread() forceBottom:false -> exact scrollTop restore; unit-tested incl. engine-hostile scrollTop clobber). Browser-level: BLOCKED by the 404 above.
2. At-bottom follows new msgs; fresh thread/conversation open at bottom — logic PASS (openThread forceBottom:true; navigation default scroll:'bottom'). Browser-level: BLOCKED.
3. Main list >= today; switch-while-scrolled-up opens at bottom — logic PASS (stale-offset defect fixed by navigation forceBottom). Browser-level: BLOCKED.
4. m= anchor fires exactly once — PASS (code-trace: anchor block unchanged, still after primitive, anchorApplied guard intact).
5. Default identity human:forrest, unset AND stale chat.me, not persisted, explicit pick still persists — logic PASS (picker options built app.js:152 before value set 163-164; fallback guarded by identityMap lookup; no localStorage write; change handler untouched; human:forrest seeded store.js:64 and present in live /api/identities). Browser-level fresh-profile check: BLOCKED.
6. Logic in public/scroll.js, unit-tested, both panes wired, no thread-DOM coupling — PASS as source; FAIL as served (the 404).
7. node --test green — PASS: 111/111, 0 fail, in the mountless compose test container (103 prior + 8 new scroll tests, arithmetic consistent with implementer claim).

Also verified: no innerHTML introduced (diff-wide grep: comment line only); no scope creep (diff = planned files + .lattice + orchestrator metawork); no external calls, no spend.

No inline fix made: registering a route is behavioral (dead app vs live app), so it goes back through the loop per the rework rules. Recommend review -> in_progress; rework is ~3 lines (STATIC_FILES entry + api.test.js static assertion mirroring AS-9's) plus re-running the manual Docker pass the implementer already flagged as undone.

Rework cycle 1 complete, commit aee772b. Fix per QA blocker: (1) registered /scroll.js in server.js STATIC_FILES (text/javascript, matching url-state.js entry); (2) added served-over-HTTP test in test/api.test.js mirroring the AS-9 url-state.js pattern — asserts 200, content-type, and renderPreservingScroll in the body. Suite in-container (docker compose run --rm test, mountless): 112 pass / 0 fail (was 111 + 1 new). Manual hand-walk done this time: built branch image, ran throwaway container (asc-chat-test image, port 8447, temp data dir; live asc-chat-server-1 untouched) — curled the full module graph: / , /app.js, /url-state.js, /scroll.js, /style.css all 200 with correct content types; /api/identities returns human:forrest so the default-identity lookup resolves. Scroll/identity logic untouched per QA instruction. Throwaway container stopped after verification.

QA re-review, cycle 2 (cold, scoped to the cycle-1 blocker per rework loop; cycle-1 passes not re-litigated).

VERDICT: PASS. Ready for merge.

Scope check: since cycle 1 the branch gained exactly two commits — aee772b (the fix) and 63ceaed (.lattice board state only). aee772b is precisely the prescribed rework, no creep: (1) one STATIC_FILES entry in server.js ('/scroll.js' -> ['scroll.js','text/javascript; charset=utf-8'], matching the url-state.js entry), (2) one served-over-HTTP test in test/api.test.js mirroring the AS-9 pattern (asserts 200, content-type, and renderPreservingScroll in the body). Nothing else touched; scroll/identity logic untouched as instructed.

Verified myself, not from the implementer's claims:
- Suite in-container (docker compose run --rm test, mountless, fresh build): 112 pass / 0 fail (111 prior + 1 new static test — arithmetic consistent).
- Blocker absence reproduced: throwaway container from the branch image (name asc-chat-qa-as17-cycle2, host port 8452, no volumes; live asc-chat-server-1 never touched). GET / , /app.js, /url-state.js, /scroll.js, /style.css all 200 with correct content-types; /scroll.js body contains renderPreservingScroll; /api/identities includes human:forrest so the default-identity lookup resolves.
- Import graph closure confirmed from the served bytes: index.html loads only /app.js (module); app.js imports only ./url-state.js and ./scroll.js; both are leaf modules with zero imports. The graph that 404'd in cycle 1 now fully resolves over HTTP.
- Throwaway container stopped and removed after verification; live server health-checked 200 afterward.

No inline fixes made. No new findings. Recommend review -> done and merge per git methodology.
